papers.title: Weak-field multi-collector benchmark
papers.hypothesis: Under matched observation and policy-capacity budgets, a bounded shared velocity summary improves fixed-horizon unique team capture yield relative to the identical-shape independent controller.
papers.kill_criterion: Stop or narrow if coupled-noise timestep validation fails, shared-minus-independent yield is non-positive or below the relevance threshold, shuffled/delayed messages explain the effect, or useful power exceeds the bounded seed cap.
papers.open_blocker: SPS-WO-07 validly failed both frozen primary continuation thresholds: mean shared-minus-independent yield 1.75 below 2.0 and 4/8 positive seeds below 5/8. SPS-C03 is dropped, SPS-WO-08 is cancelled without execution, and confirmation, further attribution seeds, and learned MARL are not authorized. A new paper question requires a theory-driven work order and fresh seeds.

papers.title: Inactive placeholder
papers.kill_criterion: No second paper may activate without a genuinely separable question and Program Director decision.

primary_question: At alpha=0.06 under the canonical four-collector task and a fixed 67-step window, does a bounded three-number shared velocity summary improve unique team capture yield over the identical-shape independent controller?
exploratory_result: SPS-WO-05 established action headroom and SPS-WO-06 passed timestep stability. SPS-WO-07 then produced a valid negative bounded-sharing diagnostic: shared-minus-independent effects [3,6,4,-3,0,0,5,-1], mean 1.75, 4/8 positive, descriptive interval [-0.375,3.75]. The frozen mean>=2 and positive>=5/8 components failed, although correctness, matched streams, shared-minus-stationary mean 1.875, and signal difference-in-differences mean 2.125 passed. The joint gate failed and SPS-C03 was closed without confirmation.

SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.purpose: Validate that dt=0.02 is a converged discretization; seeds 3001-3008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-06-TIMESTEP-CONVERGENCE.gate: absolute mean oracle-minus-stationary difference between dt=0.02 and dt=0.01 strictly below 1 particle, with at most 1/8 seed-level sign changes; dt=0.005 mandatory informational

SPS-POWER-ANALYSIS-COORDINATION.purpose: Ex-ante sensitivity analysis for 80% power at a frozen 2.0-particle minimum relevant effect; it cannot consume diagnostic outcomes

SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.purpose: Test bounded shared-summary versus local-summary headroom with stationary and alpha=0 controls; seeds 4001-4008 permanently ineligible for confirmation
SPS-WO-07-ATTRIBUTION-CONTROLS.gate: all six explicitly frozen components pass: correctness, matched streams, mean shared-minus-independent at least 2 particles, at least 5/8 positive seeds, mean shared-minus-stationary above zero, and mean alpha-adjusted shared-independent difference-in-differences above zero; descriptive only

engineering_tests.scope: 89 established simulator and inference tests plus 11 dependency-free experiment-design tests covering dyadic Brownian coupling, fixed physical duration, preregistration/config agreement, supported attribution policy IDs, ex-ante power constants, relevance-threshold failure, null-adjusted difference-in-differences failure, and matched-stream invalidation. PyTorch, Gymnasium, and pytest-dependent MARL tests are not counted because those dependencies are unavailable in this workspace.

fresh_review.strongest_new_threat: The central bounded-sharing diagnostic failed, no learned or strategic multi-agent method is evaluated, and the negative eight-seed result is not precise enough to become a decisive archival contribution.

last_engineering_action: Executed SPS-WO-07 exactly once on seeds 4001-4008: 64 episodes and 4,288 steps. The valid joint gate failed because mean shared-minus-independent yield was 1.75 below 2.0 and only 4/8 seeds were positive. No SPS-WO-08, confirmation, further attribution, or MARL run was executed.
